Name: Donut's Lantana's Anime Portrait Redesign - Winter Portrait Updated
Author: IMNOTA2
Description:
I updated the portrait based on Redesigned Sprite of Lantana made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23781]playerlyf [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25023]Orignal Portrait[/url] made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DonutSteelPeas]Donut's[/url] (DonutSteelPeas)
I found it's very cute anime portrait, but didn't have winter clothes for her to stay warm as Redesigned Sprite does. As well as the portrait in[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599] PolyamorySweet[/url] itself have new portrait expression so I've edited and drawn this for ya!

[b]Note[/b] [b]:[/b]
Though I don't know when the winter portrait and sprite will appear in game.(Someone please tell me :(   ) I will probably considering doing seasonal outfit(only available winter and normal) [b]only if[/b] I have time and no one did it, the PolyamorySweet mod updated new features about portrait and also if I want to do it. But for clearification I kinda busy with my personal life so don't expect me to do so.

Right now, you have to rename portrait you want to 'Portrait.png' but you can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] mod (I believe that Lantana have id as MermaidLantana or else you could try 'Lantana' ) There's plenty of guide out there.

[left][size=4][b]Permission[/b][/size] [b][size=3]:[/size][/b][/left]Original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25023]Donut's Lantana's Anime Portrait Redesign[/url] stated that I am allowed to modify his files and release bug fixes or improve on the features and use the assets in his file without permission as long as I credit him as the original creator.

Downloads.Description:
Extract the file and copy every file to PolyamorySweet mod. Except alter folder
If you want to use Alternative Version or want to use winter portrait for every season. Rename them to 'Portrait.png' and possibly 'Lantana' also. (I haven't test that part)
